# info-format: `DetectOutput`

The `data` payload of `openreadout info FILE --view format --json`, inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

Output of `info --view format`.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/info-format.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/info-format.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema info-format`.

## Types

### DetectConfidence

How sure detection is.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"definite"` | A format-specific signature matched. |
| `"likely"` | Structure looks right but no unique signature exists. |
| `"extension-only"` | Only the file extension matched. |
